Alex / team — locking Tue 6/29 09:00 PT for a 20-minute exec readout + 10-min Q/A. I've attached the 3-slide brief and added a short ops play on slide 3. Also included the Grafana snapshot link in the deck notes.

Attachments: MAP_perf_slides_v1.pptx (PPTX)

Ops play (inline):
- Warm-up: start traffic at 10% of target QPS for 30s, then ramp to 50% over the next 30s, reach full in additional 60s. 
- Cache note: pre-warming strategies we used: a prefix replay for top-50 prompts and a 3-minute synthetic KV walker to populate large KV maps.
- Fallback: if tail latency > p95 target, route to pinned smaller-quant variant for 60s while auto-retries reduce load.

If procurement needs the slides in PDF, say the word and we’ll send. Vivek — joining the readout; can you own the live dashboard and answer infra questions?

—Mina
